content: Use contractions for a more natural tone.
Try one clear question instead of short fragments.
Use a question form: “What would you like to chat about?”
Avoid extra full stops in spoken-style sentences.
“Chat” is the correct word here, not “cat”.
You can also say: “What would you like to talk about?”
Use a question mark for questions.
Place prepositions at the end in informal speech.
Use a question mark for direct questions.
“ID” is unclear here; perhaps you mean “idea”.
You could say: “Do you have any ideas?”
